projects = [163, 22, 195, 122]

for pid in projects:
    resp = apis.todoist.show_tasks(project_id=pid, access_token=access_token, assignee_email='jes.mill@gmail.com', is_completed=False)
    # resp is dict with sections and no_section_tasks
    # collect from no_section_tasks

        all_tasks.append(t)

        for t in sec.get('tasks', []):
